description: CAT-NEW, argument selection. In one process, one fresh scratch file per case, DBEngine.Errors read right before and after each call, Version and CollatingOrder read back: an .mdb name with omitted Option, with 128 and with 64; an .accdb name with Option as VT_I2 128, BSTR "128", VT_R8 128, 192 (64+128) and 2 (dbEncrypt alone); Workspace.CreateDatabase with 64 on an .accdb name. Asks whether the extension chooses the format when Option is omitted, and which numeric forms and combinations are accepted.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
